about.nl: Door de auteurs gepubliceerde metingen. Percentages komen uit verschillende proeven en zijn niet onderling uitwisselbaar. De cijfers bewijzen geen effect van textGrain op afzonderlijke antwoorden of IdeaLens-uitslagen.
about.en: Measurements published by the authors. Percentages come from different experiments and are not interchangeable. They do not establish a textGrain effect on individual answers or IdeaLens classifications.

openai_post.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules

openai_help.title: Provenance signals in content processed by OpenAI tools

idealens.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing

astra_benchmarks.interpretation: OpenAI reports no meaningful aggregate differences; individual rows have benchmark-specific scales and do not measure changes in a single answer.

length_detection.dataset: ELI5, questions in subjects such as psychology
length_detection.limitation: OpenAI reports substantially lower detection on mathematics without giving those values in the accompanying article text.

synonym_edit.limitation: Different evaluation from the psychology/length comparison. Do not assume the same 400-token baseline or compare them as one sample.

language_range.notes: OpenAI strengthened the watermark for languages under 60%; the published page text does not provide all post-adjustment language-specific values.

idea_shift.limitation: Controlled AI prose from prompts containing plans. The AI-flag rate is not authorship certainty.

twice_told.limitation: Small controlled sample, writers followed AI-sourced outlines; cannot generalize to all human-AI writing.

outline_stability.limitation: Subsample sizes for these stability groups are not stated in the public article text; repeatability near the classification boundary is weaker.

aggregate_detection.dataset: shared versus mixed idea/prose provenance across evaluation splits
aggregate_detection.limitation: Aggregated evaluation settings, not individual author-truth probabilities. Models target different provenance constructs.
